description: Use this when the user asks how fast a public page responds (DNS, connect, TTFB, total time, weight, request count, score). Slower than other checks (up to ~60s). Not a connection speed test — for that, send them to https://speedtest.lanetti.fi/. Read-only, powered by Lanetti Tools.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com/path. Localhost, private and metadata addresses are rejected.

name: oma_check_page_speed
title: Check page speed
